name: gooten-mcp
description: Gooten (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_order, get_order, track. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_gooten_recipe_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOTEN_RECIPE_ID
platform_mcp_gooten_recipe_id.description: Gooten RecipeID (public key, Admin Panel > Settings > API), sent as the `recipeid` query parameter on every call.

platform_mcp_gooten_partner_billing_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOTEN_PARTNER_BILLING_KEY
platform_mcp_gooten_partner_billing_key.description: Gooten PartnerBillingKey (private key from the same API settings page), sent inside create_order's Payment object so Gooten bills your account; required only for create_order.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists the supported shipping countries ({Countries[{Name, Code, IsSupported, DefaultCurrency}]}) for the RecipeID.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Your Print Ready Products (products already combined with your artwork): {PageCount, Page, Products[{ProductName, NumberOfVariants}]}. `query`, `category` and `limit` are not accepted (Gooten sets the page size). Gooten's base catalogue is a static CDN file (productdatav3/catalog.json), not an API call.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Submits a LIVE order billed to your Gooten account through the PartnerBillingKey (IsInTestMode is not sent). `shipping_address` is Gooten's address {FirstName, LastName, Line1, Line2, City, State, CountryCode, PostalCode, Phone, Email} and is also used as BillingAddress; `items` are Gooten items [{SKU, Quantity, ShipType (standard|expedited|overnight), Images[{Url}]}] - the shipping method is per item, so `shipping_option` is not sent. Answers {Id} (the order id get_order takes); validation failures come back as HadError=true with Errors[{PropertyName, ErrorMessage}].

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET orders/?id= : {Id, NiceId, SourceId, Items[{Sku, Quantity, Status, TrackingNumber, TrackingUrl, ShipCarrierName, Price{Price, CurrencyCode}, Shipments[]}], ShipToAddress, ...}. Gooten tracks status per item; `status`/`tracking_number` are the first item's. Order totals are per item (Items[].Price) and not mapped to `total`.

tools.name: track
tools.description: One row per order item with its status, carrier and tracking number/URL (Items[].Shipments holds split shipments, in `raw`).
